description: This file implements and manages a string list data structure with functions for initialization, insertion, removal, searching, sorting, and splitting of string lists. It provides mechanisms for duplicate handling, ownership, and various utility operations related to string list management.

methods.name: void string_list_init_nodup(struct string_list * list)
methods.description: Initialize a string_list without duplicating strings, copying the provided list into a clean state.

methods.name: void string_list_init_dup(struct string_list * list)
methods.description: Initialize a string_list with duplication of strings, preparing it for use with duplicating string entries.

methods.name: struct:string_list_item * string_list_insert(struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Insert a string into the list, inserting in sorted order and returning a pointer to the inserted item.

methods.name: void string_list_remove(struct string_list * list,const char * string,int free_util)
methods.description: Remove a string from the list, freeing associated memory if owned.

methods.name: bool string_list_has_string(const struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Check if a string exists exactly in the list.

methods.name: size_t string_list_find_insert_index(const struct string_list * list,const char * string,bool * exact_match)
methods.description: Find the index at which a string can be inserted, optionally returning whether an exact match exists.

methods.name: struct:string_list_item * string_list_lookup(struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Lookup a string in the list and return its item if found.

methods.name: void string_list_remove_duplicates(struct string_list * list,int free_util)
methods.description: Remove duplicate entries from a string list.

methods.name: int for_each_string_list(struct string_list * list,string_list_each_func_t fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Iterate over each string list item, applying a callback function.

methods.name: void filter_string_list(struct string_list * list,int free_util,string_list_each_func_t want,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Filter items in the list based on a predicate callback, removing items that do not satisfy the predicate.

methods.name: void string_list_remove_empty_items(struct string_list * list,int free_util)
methods.description: Remove empty string items from the list.

methods.name: void string_list_clear(struct string_list * list,int free_util)
methods.description: Clear the list, freeing all items if owned.

methods.name: void string_list_clear_func(struct string_list * list,string_list_clear_func_t clearfunc)
methods.description: Clear the list using a custom function to free item utilities.

methods.name: void string_list_setlen(struct string_list * list,size_t nr)
methods.description: Set the length of the string list; used when the list owns its entries.

methods.name: struct:string_list_item * string_list_append(struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Append a string to the list, duplicating if necessary.

methods.name: void string_list_sort(struct string_list * list)
methods.description: Sort the string list using the provided compare function.

methods.name: struct:string_list_item * unsorted_string_list_lookup(struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Lookup a string in an unsorted list efficiently.

methods.name: int unsorted_string_list_has_string(struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Check if a string exists in an unsorted list.

methods.name: void unsorted_string_list_delete_item(struct string_list * list,int i,int free_util)
methods.description: Delete an item from an unsorted list at a given index.

methods.name: int string_list_split(struct string_list * list,const char * string,const char * delim,int maxsplit)
methods.description: Split a string into a list of substrings based on delimiters, with optional trimming and splitting options.

methods.name: int string_list_split_in_place(struct string_list * list,char * string,const char * delim,int maxsplit)
methods.description: Split a string into a list of substrings in place, modifying the original string.

methods.name: int string_list_split_f(struct string_list * list,const char * string,const char * delim,int maxsplit,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Split a string with additional flags controlling the splitting behavior.

methods.name: int string_list_split_in_place_f(struct string_list * list,char * string,const char * delim,int maxsplit,unsigned flags)
methods.description: In-place splitting with flags.
